title: Thermodynamic Guardrails: Real-Time Monitoring of Physical Consistency in Stochastic Biochemical Models

contributions.purpose: 在不预知参数有效区间的前提下让简化生化模型自检失效
contributions.mechanism: 基于 bond graph 形式重构 stQSSA 全态,逐步计算化学亲和度与流的乘积(净功率 P=A·J),P<0 即违反热力学第二定律触发切换到完整 Gillespie SSA
contributions.evaluation: 在紧结合等摩尔失效工况下 t≈2.7s 检出违规,早于慢变量 P 误差变灾难
contributions.domain: 随机生化模型约简 / 自主科学 agent
contributions.source_quote: the guardrail identifies the stQSSA's failure by detecting negative power flow—the product of chemical affinity and flux—which signifies a thermodynamic violation.

contributions.purpose: 揭示诊断成功后状态交接(self-correction)仍失败
contributions.mechanism: 触发后用守恒量重初始化完整 SSA,对比与 ground-truth SSA 轨迹
contributions.evaluation: 负结果:朴素重初始化无法修正 stQSSA 累积积分误差,混合模型偏离真值(尤其 [E] 轨迹),因触发时 [ES] 已显著错误
contributions.source_quote: even with the error detected, naive re-initialization is insufficient to correct the integrated error accumulated by the stQSSA, suggesting other, effective hand-off methods must be employed.

contributions.purpose: 评估守恒率监测的计算代价与不同守恒类型优劣
contributions.mechanism: 对 450 条轨迹测平均墙钟时间;参数扫描(k1/k2/k-1 在 [1e-2,1e2])比较 elementary vs net 守恒的 IAE 热图
contributions.evaluation: 开销可忽略(SSA 0.0005s vs 混合/stQSSA 均 0.0003s);热图结果含糊(蓝红混杂),elementary 守恒从未触发
contributions.source_quote: The parameter sweep analysis (Figure 4) ... yields ambiguous results. The heatmaps show a mixture of blue regions ... and red regions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: While bond graphs have been primarily discussed as a tool for building thermodynamically consistent models from the ground up, their potential for the real-time, dynamic validation of approximate models remains a novel area of exploration. This work addresses this specific gap, proposing that the thermodynamic principles inherent in the bond graph formalism can be repurposed ... as an internal consistency check.
Unlike parameter-based switches that require a priori knowledge of a model's specific validity conditions (e.g., the A_T·K_d < 10 rule for ASSISTER), the thermodynamic check is universal.

notes: 诚实负结果为全文核心之一:诊断(guardrail)成功但纠错(hand-off)失败,承认 integrated error 问题需更复杂算法;参数扫描热图 '含糊'(net 守恒有输有赢),elementary 守恒从未触发。trade-off/数字:计算开销 SSA 0.0005s vs 混合 0.0003s(≈40% 省时)但接受度靠诊断价值而非速度。AI 自我披露充分:作者列 Gemini 2.5 Pro 与 Liner AI;结论述 AI 用于假设/文献/审稿,并自认 'the AI agent often hallucinated equalities or inequalities',提醒需人工监督防止过度依赖 AI 逻辑——这是难得的可信度自省而非红旗。图1/2 为真实仿真曲线,源码承诺随附。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳。
